verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents incremental review: `@coderabbitai review` covers only new changes, while `full review` re-reviews the whole PR. Auto-review settings imply reviews run as commits arrive, since they can pause after a set number of commits. The request-changes workflow stays synchronized with resolved feedback, but nothing explicitly says a re-review tracks which earlier findings were fixed or avoids repeating old comments. Missing for 10: explicit docs that a push automatically triggers an incremental re-review, evidence that prior comments are marked fixed or resolved rather than repeated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
